entities.name: Porphobilinogen deaminase Q9HMY5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Halobacterium salinarum UniProt Q9HMY5; annotated as probable porphobilinogen deaminase.
Catalyzes assembly of four porphobilinogen molecules into hydroxymethylbilane, a precursor in porphyrin/heme biosynthesis.
Associated annotations include hydroxymethylbilane synthase activity (GO:0004418) and heme biosynthetic process (GO:0006783).
Cytoplasmic localization is annotated for homologs, not directly established for the exact-match reference in retrieved results.
Sequence length 396 aa; calculated molecular mass approximately 42.8 kDa.

entities.name: Heme biosynthesis
observations: The exact-match reference is annotated for the heme biosynthetic process; porphobilinogen deaminase forms hydroxymethylbilane from porphobilinogen.
